import numpy as np


def ring(n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    angle = rng.integers(0, 8, n) * np.pi / 4
    centre = np.stack([2 * np.cos(angle), 2 * np.sin(angle)], axis=1)
    return centre + rng.normal(0, 0.1, (n, 2))


angles = np.arange(8) * np.pi / 4
CENTRES = np.stack([2 * np.cos(angles), 2 * np.sin(angles)], axis=1)
T = 100
betas = np.linspace(1e-4, 0.1, T)
alphas = 1 - betas
alpha_bar = np.cumprod(alphas)
x0 = ring(2000, 0)


def noisy_near(t, seed):
    eps = np.random.default_rng(seed).normal(size=x0.shape)
    xt = np.sqrt(alpha_bar[t]) * x0 + np.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar[t]) * eps
    dist = np.linalg.norm(xt[:, None] - CENTRES[None], axis=2)
    near = (dist.min(axis=1) < 0.3).mean()
    return [round(float(near), 3), round(float(xt.std()), 2)]


for t in [0, 29, 99]:
    print(t, noisy_near(t, 1))
```
